product_overview: Spotbook is a mobile-first marketplace connecting clients and professionals via a TikTok-style service video feed, appointment booking with Stripe deposits, and event ticketing with QR validation. The app enforces role-based experiences (Client vs Pro) and uses Supabase + Edge Functions for backend operations.
core_goals: Provide secure role-based authentication and routing so users land on the correct Client or Pro experience after login.
Deliver a high-performance, moderated vertical video feed showing only approved Pro videos.
Enable reliable, atomic booking and ticket purchase flows with Stripe payments handled via server-side Edge Functions.
Support Pro features: video upload (moderated), event creation/ticketing with QR validation, and a dashboard for stats and payouts.
Ensure robust offline/error UX, consistent design tokens, and platform-appropriate fallbacks (e.g. limited web capabilities).

features.name: Splash & Auth Routing
features.description: Entry point that checks auth/session state and routes users to onboarding, login, or the appropriate role shell (Client feed or Pro dashboard).
user_flows: GET supabase.auth.currentSession -> Receive 200 with session {userId, role:'client'} -> GET supabase.from('users').select() with userId -> Receive 200 with profile.role='client' -> App navigates to /client/feed
GET supabase.auth.currentSession -> Receive 200 with session {userId, role:'pro'} -> GET supabase.from('profiles_pro').select() with userId -> Receive 200 -> App navigates to /pro/dashboard
GET supabase.auth.currentSession -> Receive 200 with null session -> No server session -> App navigates to /onboarding
GET supabase.auth.currentSession -> Receive 200 with session but missing role -> App navigates to /onboarding

features.name: Onboarding (first-launch)
features.description: Three-slide onboarding that introduces the product and sets the user's chosen role before signup.
user_flows: Tap Get Started -> Write Hive box 'prefs'.put('onboarding_completed', true) -> Navigate to /account-type
Tap Skip -> Write Hive box 'prefs'.put('onboarding_completed', true) -> Navigate to /login
Complete slides then tap Get Started -> Attempt to write Hive prefs but Hive write fails (I/O error) -> Show inline error and allow retry

features.name: User Sign Up
features.description: Multi-step registration where user selects role (Client or Pro) and creates an account via Supabase; profile inserts follow signup.
user_flows: POST supabase.auth.signUp with {email, password} -> Receive 200 with userId -> POST supabase.from('users').insert() with profile (userId, role) -> Receive 201 -> Navigate to /complete-profile
POST supabase.auth.signUp with invalid email/password -> Receive 400 with validation error -> Show inline validation messages and keep user on signup screen
POST supabase.auth.signUp with valid credentials -> Receive 200 but subsequent supabase.from('users').insert() returns 409 (unique constraint) -> Show error and surface retry option

features.name: User Login (Email/Password & Google OAuth)
features.description: Authenticate users via Supabase email/password or Google OAuth and route them based on stored role or onboarding status.
user_flows: POST supabase.auth.signInWithPassword with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with session and access token -> GET supabase.from('users').select() with session.user.id -> Receive 200 with role='client' -> Navigate to /client/feed
POST supabase.auth.signInWithOAuth (Google) -> Supabase OAuth redirect/flow completes -> Receive 200 session -> GET supabase.from('users').select() -> If profile missing navigate to /complete-profile
POST supabase.auth.signInWithPassword with wrong password -> Receive 401 Unauthorized -> Display error 'Invalid credentials' and allow retry

features.name: Complete Profile
features.description: After signup the user provides display name, avatar and basic bio; flow differs by role (client -> interest selection, pro -> business details).
user_flows: POST supabase.from('users').update() with {id, display_name, avatar_url, bio} -> Receive 200 -> If role='client' navigate to /client/interests
POST supabase.from('users').update() with {id, display_name, avatar_url, bio} -> Receive 200 -> If role='pro' navigate to /pro/business-details
POST supabase.from('users').update() with invalid payload -> Receive 400 -> Show field-level validation errors and prevent navigation

features.name: Video Feed (Client & Pro feed screens)
features.description: TikTok-style vertical autoplay feed showing only approved Pro videos with like, comment, share and book interactions.
user_flows: GET supabase.from('videos').select() with filter status='approved' + pagination -> Receive 200 with list of videos -> Render vertical feed and autoplay first video
POST supabase.from('video_likes').insert() with {userId, videoId} -> Receive 201 -> Update local like count and animate heart
GET supabase.from('videos').select() with network failure -> Receive network error -> Show EmptyState/OfflineBanner and a retry action

features.name: Discover & Search
features.description: Search and filter professionals and services by category, location, rating or price.
user_flows: GET supabase.from('profiles_pro').select() with query q=searchText & filters -> Receive 200 with matching pro profiles -> Display results grid
GET supabase.from('services').select() with proId filter -> Receive 200 with services list when user opens a Pro profile -> Show services in booking sheet
GET supabase.from('profiles_pro').select() with rate limit exceeded -> Receive 429 -> Show rate-limit error and suggest waiting or refine search

features.name: Upload Video (Pro only)
features.description: Pro uploads a service video that is compressed, uploaded to Cloudflare Stream via a TUS URL, and inserted as a DB record in pending_review status.
user_flows: POST supabase.functions.invoke('generate-cloudflare-upload-url') with {filename, length} -> Receive 200 with TUS upload URL -> PUT <TUS upload URL> with video bytes -> Receive 201 with cloudflareId
POST supabase.from('videos').insert() with {proId, cloudflareId, title, category, description, status:'pending_review'} -> Receive 201 -> App shows MyVideos item with status pending_review
POST supabase.functions.invoke('generate-cloudflare-upload-url') by a Client account -> Receive 403 Forbidden -> Show 'Only Pros can upload videos' error
PUT <TUS upload URL> with video bytes larger than allowed limit -> Receive 413 Payload Too Large -> Show validation error and reject upload

features.name: Bookings Management & Booking Flow
features.description: Multi-step booking flow (service -> date -> time -> promo -> summary -> payment) that creates an atomic booking via Edge Function after Stripe payment.
user_flows: GET supabase.from('services').select() with proId -> Receive 200 with available services -> User selects service

POST supabase.functions.invoke('stripe-create-intent') with {amount_cents, currency, idempotency_key} -> Receive 200 with PaymentIntent client_secret -> Confirm payment via Stripe SDK -> Receive payment succeeded
POST supabase.functions.invoke('create-booking-atomic') with {serviceId, timeSlotId, payment_intent_id} -> Receive 201 with bookingId and status 'confirmed' -> Navigate to /client/bookings
POST supabase.functions.invoke('stripe-create-intent') -> Receive 402 payment_failed from Stripe -> Do not call create-booking-atomic -> Show payment error and keep booking in pending_payment

features.name: Bookings Cancellation
features.description: Clients cancel upcoming bookings; cancellation rules applied server-side via Edge Function and refund logic executed by Stripe via the function.
user_flows: POST supabase.functions.invoke('cancel-booking') with {bookingId} -> Receive 200 with {status:'cancelled', refund_status:'processed'} -> MyBookings list reflects cancellation

POST supabase.functions.invoke('cancel-booking') with booking within 24h -> Receive 200 with {status:'cancelled', refund_status:'partial', message:'No refund of deposit due to policy'} -> Show policy message to user
POST supabase.functions.invoke('cancel-booking') with invalid bookingId -> Receive 404 Not Found -> Show error 'Booking not found' and allow contact support

features.name: Event Details & Ticket Purchase
features.description: View event details and buy tickets; Stripe payment is created via Edge Function and ticket record created with server-generated QR hash.
user_flows: GET supabase.from('events').select() with eventId -> Receive 200 with event and ticket types -> User selects ticket type

POST supabase.functions.invoke('stripe-create-ticket-intent') with {ticketTypeId, amount_cents} -> Receive 200 with PaymentIntent client_secret -> Confirm PaymentIntent via Stripe SDK -> Receive succeeded
POST supabase.functions.invoke('stripe-create-ticket-intent') completed -> Server creates ticket record with qr_hash and returns ticketId -> Navigate to TicketDetailScreen (show QR code)
POST supabase.functions.invoke('stripe-create-ticket-intent') -> Receive 402 Payment Failed -> Show payment failure and allow retry

features.name: Ticket Scanner (Pro at event)
features.description: Pro scans a ticket QR code and validates it via an Edge Function which marks the ticket as used when valid.
user_flows: POST supabase.functions.invoke('validate-qr-ticket') with {qr_hash, eventId} -> Receive 200 with {status:'valid', ticketId} -> App shows green confirmation and HapticFeedback.heavy
POST supabase.functions.invoke('validate-qr-ticket') with {qr_hash} that is already used -> Receive 200 with {status:'used'} -> App shows orange 'Already scanned' overlay
POST supabase.functions.invoke('validate-qr-ticket') with invalid qr_hash -> Receive 404 -> Show red 'Invalid ticket' and prevent entry

features.name: Chat (Realtime messaging)
features.description: Real-time messaging between client and pro backed by Supabase Realtime and persisted in messages table.
user_flows: POST supabase.from('conversations').insert() with {bookingId, clientId, proId} -> Receive 201 with conversationId -> Subscribe to Supabase Realtime channel for conversationId -> Receive confirmation of subscription
POST supabase.from('messages').insert() with {conversationId, senderId, content} -> Receive 201 -> Realtime subscription emits a new_message event to the recipient -> Render incoming message
Subscribe to Realtime channel -> Subscription fails due to network error -> Show offline indicator and queue outgoing messages locally until connection restored

features.name: Client Profile
features.description: User can view and edit their client profile, see favorites, bookings history, and tickets.
user_flows: GET supabase.from('users').select() with userId -> Receive 200 with profile fields -> Render ClientProfileScreen with tabs Favorites, Bookings, Tickets
POST supabase.from('users').update() with {id, display_name, city, bio} -> Receive 200 -> Reflect updated values in UI
GET supabase.from('users').select() -> Receive 403 Forbidden due to expired session -> Redirect to /login

features.name: Settings & Sign Out
features.description: Manage account settings, notification preferences and sign out.
user_flows: POST supabase.auth.signOut() -> Receive 200 -> Clear local Hive session and navigate to /login
POST supabase.from('notification_preferences').update() with userId and toggles -> Receive 200 -> Persist preferences on server
POST supabase.auth.signOut() -> Network error occurs -> Show SnackBar 'Could not sign out. Check your connection.' and keep user signed in

tech_stack: Supabase (backend - auth, database, storage, edge functions)
